Q8485.reason: In Nicaragua and Oil Platforms the ICJ treated a series of incidents as capable of amounting cumulatively to an armed attack, so it was not hostile to accumulation.

Q8487.reason: The reasonable-person standard is objective and adjusts for physical disability, while mental disability generally does not lower the standard.

Q8491.reason: Durkheim links mechanical solidarity to repressive penal law and organic solidarity to restitutive law.
